ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "FAIL", "code": vars.responseOrderIni.body.operationResult as String, "message": (vars.responseOrderIni.body.operationResultDescription default "Error - creación orden") as String, "orderStep": "creación orden" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "FAIL", "code": payload.body.operationResult, "message": (payload.header.service.statusDetail default "Error - Orden Creada") as String, "orderStep": "Orden Creada", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "FAIL", "code": payload.body.operationResult, "message": (payload.header.service.statusDetail default "Error - Creación Orden Servicio") as String, "orderStep": "Creación Orden Servicio", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "FAIL", "code": payload.body.operationResult, "message": (payload.header.service.statusDetail default "Error - Cliente Cargado") as String, "orderStep": "Cliente Cargado", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": 'FAIL', "code": payload.code as String, "message": (payload.description default "Error - Consulta Inventario") as String, "orderStep": "Consulta Inventario", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": 'FAIL', "code": payload.errorCode as String, "message": (payload.errorDescription default "Error - Reserva SIM") as String, "orderStep": "Reserva SIM", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload ++ { "orderStep": "Error - Actualización activación", "orderNumber": vars.responseOrderIni.body.databaseId }
